election: NYC 2021 primary, REP Borough President Queens
notes: NYC Board of Elections cast vote record (PE2021_CVR_Final.zip), contest code 24549. Ballot allowed 3 ranks. Cleanup follows the BOE rules (see data/nyc/README.md). Records with any mark in this contest: 14341; with an overvote: 88; with a skipped rank: 414; with a repeated candidate: 395. Blank ballots: 2632 with no marks (estimated from ballot styles), 74 whose first marked rank was an overvote. No certified round-by-round page found (or winner name not matched), so official_winners is null. The BOE posted no count for this contest. Ballotpedia lists the 2021 Republican primary for Queens Borough President as canceled, with Thomas Zmich advancing to the general election and Danniel Maio withdrawn or disqualified; the contest was still printed on ballots, which is why the CVR has marks for it. The CVR's two candidate IDs are missing from the BOE's name list, and no public source we found ties either ID to a name.
